chain.title: Start the Workshop's Foundation
chain.desc: Make Black Iron using the installed recipe. Reserve it for components and workstations rather than treating every advanced craft as available immediately.

chain.title: Prepare the Structural Pieces
chain.desc: Turn Black Iron into slates. These are part of the component and workstation crafting routes.

chain.title: Light for the Components
chain.desc: Prepare Luminessence with the recipe viewer. It joins the Black Iron branch in many of the mod's crafting components.

chain.title: The First Crafting Component
chain.desc: Make Basic Components and inspect the matching catalyst and table recipes. Produce enough for the first workstation without exhausting your materials.

chain.title: Focus the First Table
chain.desc: Build a Basic Catalyst using the installed recipe. Catalysts are components of the table progression and other configured crafts.

chain.title: A Persistent Crafting Grid
chain.desc: Build the Basic Crafting Table. Its 3-by-3 grid retains items when closed and supports the mod's table recipes.

chain.title: Expand to Five by Five
chain.desc: Prepare the advanced components and construct the 5-by-5 table. Use recipes available in your pack; larger tables do not create recipes that were never configured.

chain.title: Seven by Seven
chain.desc: Build the Elite Crafting Table for 7-by-7 recipes. Plan material supply before attempting a large grid recipe.

chain.title: The Nine-by-Nine Workbench
chain.desc: Complete the Ultimate Crafting Table. Choose a real installed recipe as the workshop's final project rather than assuming every pack includes the same endgame item.

chain.title: Automate a Saved Table Recipe
chain.desc: Build an Auto Crafting Table, save a supported recipe and provide its required power and ingredients. Use the documented input chest arrangement and extract the output.

chain.title: A Powered Centerpiece
chain.desc: Build a Crafting Core for Combination Crafting. It is a separate in-world system, not another oversized crafting grid.

chain.title: Lay Out the Combination Recipe
chain.desc: Place pedestals around the Core at the same height and within its supported radius. The Core holds the center item while the pedestals hold the surrounding ingredients.

chain.title: Finish a Combination Craft
chain.desc: Supply power and the ingredients for an installed Combination Crafting recipe, then collect its output. Confirm after the Core completes the operation.

chain.title: Turn Bulk Supply into a Project
chain.desc: Build the Quantum Compressor and inspect an enabled recipe. Supply its required catalyst, material quantity and power; requirements are pack-defined.

chain.title: Compress a Real Material Supply
chain.desc: Complete one enabled singularity recipe in the Quantum Compressor. Confirm after collecting the finished singularity and restocking the machine for another batch.

chain.title: Material for the Ender Branch
chain.desc: Prepare Ender Ingots with the installed recipe. They open a separate timed-crafting system rather than requiring a completed singularity.

chain.title: Craft with Alternators
chain.desc: Build an Ender Crafter and place Ender Alternators within its documented range. Supported recipes take time; more alternators improve the process.

chain.title: Make the Large Recipe Work
chain.desc: Select an enabled endgame recipe that uses this workshop and produce its output. Confirm after the actual craft succeeds, using compression or Ender Crafting only if that recipe calls for them.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Tiered tables plus independent combination, compression and Ender Crafting systems; pack-defined endgame projects.
coverage.limitations: Checked against 6.0.10 recipes and bundled guide. Pack authors configure major recipes and singularities; manual milestones require an enabled installed recipe. No universal ATM Star or Creative item is fabricated.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
